title: The 10 elements
and the
reply-all
tag_line: Send this to the colleague who saw it too.

Wood.yang: Writes the polite 'please remove me' note.
Wood.yin: Quietly makes a filter. Peace again.

Fire.yang: Replies all with a joke. Gets 12 likes.
Fire.yin: Screenshots it for the work chat.

Earth.yang: Messages the sender kindly in private.
Earth.yin: Worries it was them. Checks twice.

Metal.yang: Asks IT to lock the list. Done by noon.
Metal.yin: Spots the typo in the original email.

Water.yang: Already knew who'd do it. Popcorn time.
Water.yin: Mutes the thread. Never sees the drama.

comment_line: Which one is your office? Comment below.
caption:
Send this to the colleague who saw that reply-all too 📧

One email, 300 replies, and every element copes its own way: one writes the polite 'please remove me', one cracks a joke, one quietly makes a filter. Which one are you, and which one sits next to you?

Your element comes from the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find yours free at the link in bio.

Which one is your office? Comment below.
